title: Small Harnesses, Default Checks, Limited Coverage: Bounded Model Checking in Practice
abstract: arXiv:2611.19267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing use of AI to generate software and verification artifacts has increased the need for automated systems that provide reliable software assurance. Bounded model checking (BMC) offers a practical foundation for such systems by automatically checking correctness and security properties directly on software. However, effective verification requires choices about properties, input assumptions, function models, and execution bounds that influence the guarantees obtained. Little systematic evidence exists on how practitioners make these choices, limiting the empirical foundation for developing automated verification systems.   We present an empirical study of BMC practices in open-source C and Rust projects using CBMC and Kani. Through LLM-assisted open coding, static analysis, and artifact execution, we characterize verification properties, artifact complexity, and verification outcomes. translated_title: 小型测试桩、默认检查、有限覆盖：实践中的有界模型检测
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能在生成软件和验证工件方面应用的日益增多，对能够提供可靠软件保障的自动化系统的需求也随之增长。有界模型检测通过直接在软件上自动检查正确性和安全属性，为这类系统提供了实用的基础。然而，有效的验证需要对验证属性、输入假设、函数模型和执行边界等做出选择，而这些选择会影响所获得的保证程度。目前关于从业者如何做出这些选择的系统性证据很少，这限制了开发自动化验证系统的实证基础。我们对开源 C 和 Rust 项目中使用 CBMC 和 Kani 的有界模型检测实践进行了一项实证研究。通过大语言模型辅助的开放式编码、静态分析和工件执行，我们刻画了验证属性、工件复杂度以及验证结果。我们的发现揭示了多样化的验证目标……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文对开源 C 与 Rust 项目中使用 CBMC 和 Kani 进行有界模型检测的实际实践开展了实证研究，刻画了验证属性、工件复杂度与验证结果，揭示了实践中存在测试桩规模小、依赖默认检查且覆盖有限等问题，为构建自动化软件验证系统提供了重要的实证基础。
en_tdlr: An empirical study of bounded model checking practices in open-source C and Rust projects using CBMC and Kani, characterizing verification properties, artifact complexity, and outcomes, revealing small harnesses, default checks, and limited coverage, thereby providing an empirical foundation for building automated verification systems.
